descriptionChirho: Gray or white hair as a physical feature, often used as a dignified marker of age; includes construct forms, pronominal suffixes ('my gray hair,' 'his gray hair,' 'gray hair of'), and conjunctive prefixes.

Gray hair used metonymically for old age itself, typically appearing with preposition ב ('in old age') or with pronominal suffixes in the sense of one's time of old age; multilingual glosses consistently render this as 'old age' (vejez, uzee, 노년) rather than literal 'gray hair.'
